t: The DeWalt Red Cloud body warmer in black offers a practical layering solution for demanding work environments. Constructed from 100% durable nylon rip-stop, it provides lasting wear and is suitable for tradespeople requiring warmth without restricting movement, such as electricians on site or plumbers working indoors. Stretch fleece side panels enhance comfort and flexibility throughout the workday. Storage for small tools and essentials is provided by two lower front pockets and a secure zipped chest pocket, while a robust YKK front zip ensures reliable fastening. This work gilet is also machine washable for easy care.
b: 2 x Lower Front & 1 x Zipped Chest Pocket(s)
